title: Prosecution drops 3 articles, retains Article II in Sara Duterte impeachment trial
summary: The House prosecution panel on Tuesday dropped three out of the four Articles of Impeachment leveled against Vice President Sara Duterte, saying its case will stand on Article II alone on alleged…

blocks.text: The prosecution on Tuesday withdrew three articles in the Articles of Impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

House lead prosecutor Rep. Gerville Luistro read the manifestation at the Senate impeachment court saying the prosecution was dropping Article I on confidential funds, Article III on bribery, and Article IV on threats against President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos, First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos, and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
The prosecution retained Article II on unexplained wealth. —KG, GMA News
